aggregate_delta_acc.method: percentile bootstrap on the mean of a small (n=seeds) sample of deltas

aggregate_delta_macro_f1.method: percentile bootstrap on the mean of a small (n=seeds) sample of deltas

interpretation: Across 7 seeds, mean Delta_acc = +0.0302 (std 0.0073), 95% CI [+0.0244, +0.0351]. Wilcoxon signed-rank p=0.0156 vs a median-0 null. Mean exceeds +0.020 and the sign is consistent enough for Wilcoxon to reach significance at this seed count; the multi-seed CI overlaps the paper's single-seed estimate (+0.0283, CI [0.0199, 0.0368]), so the single-seed figure is not an outlier of the split-seed distribution.
